verdict.rationale: Raygun documents first-party bulk actions in the dashboard: you can select multiple error groups with checkboxes and change their status at once (raygun-docs-41), and you can export all or selected error groups (raygun-docs-9, raygun-docs-46). These are UI-driven, though, and nothing shows bulk operations reachable programmatically or by an agent. An official MCP server exists (raygun-probe-3), but no evidence shows it supports bulk actions, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404 (raygun-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented programmatic or API-level bulk operations, evidence that the MCP server supports batch actions, bulk actions beyond status changes and export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
